events.verdict: Burks (CLE) sets the screen on Allen (CLE) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Thompson (CLE) sets the screen on Kurucs (BKN) and makes some contact with his arm, but does not prevent him from disengaging.
Allen (BKN) makes marginal contact with Hill (CLE) off ball.
Kurucs (BKN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Allen (BKN) sets the pick on Clarkson (CLE) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Crabbe (BKN) and Thompson (CLE) briefly engage and separate off ball.

Crabbe (BKN) grabs Thompson's (CLE) shorts, which prevents Thompson from being able to move freely to attempt to get possession of the missed shot. With the first foul being on Crabbe, Thompson now must make a swim move to establish a good rebounding position.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Clarkson (CLE) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Russell (BKN) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Thompson (CLE) and Allen (BKN) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Clarkson (CLE) does not make contact with the ball while it is in the cylinder.
Thompson (CLE) sets the screen on Kurucs (BKN) and does not deliver contact.
Hill (CLE) makes some contact with Dinwiddie's (BKN) arm during the rebound, but does not affect his ability to control the loose ball.
Thompson (CLE) and Kurucs (BKN) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Hill (CLE) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Burks (CLE) jumps A to B and makes body and arm contact with Kurucs (BKN) that affects his ability to follow-through naturally.
Dinwiddie (BKN) and Hood (CLE) briefly engage and separate before the pick.
Hood (CLE) makes marginal contact with Crabbe (BKN) while setting the screen and does not affect his ability to defend the play.
Crabbe (BKN) wraps Hood (CLE), preventing him from rolling to the basket.
Burks (CLE) makes marginal contact with Dinwiddie (BKN) during his drive to the basket and does not affect his ability to maintain his defensive position.
Hood (CLE) makes tactile contact with Crabbe (BKN) as he is using the screen.
Burks (CLE) briefly engages with Dinwiddie (BKN) during the screen and does not affect his FOM.
Thompson (CLE) legally contests Dinwiddie's (BKN) shot attempt.
